method.clock: UTC elapsed hours from the first logged training row at zero-based step 0 to an evaluation row
method.includes: All intervening wall time, including evaluations, checkpointing, retries, preemption waits and replay
method.excludes: Initial scheduling, process startup and compilation before the first logged step 0
method.threshold_selection: Descriptive round loss levels selected after observing the completed ladder; not preregistered
method.sampling: All recorded Paloma evaluations, normally each quarter of updates plus the final evaluation
method.interpretation: First observed evaluation at or below a threshold, with its previous sampled evaluation; no interpolation
method.bracket_limit: The previous sample is above threshold when present, but unsampled non-monotonic crossings are not excluded
method.no_hit: No recorded evaluation met the threshold; unsampled crossings are not excluded
method.not_compute_time: This clock is operational latency for this execution, not uninterrupted optimizer training time or GPU efficiency
method.runtime_policy: W&B _runtime and last-attempt durations are not used
method.query_bounds: Exact 28 selected IDs only; initial training steps 0 through 5 and evaluation history bounded by each target update count

limitations: One seed per recipe and budget; no uncertainty estimate or statistical significance claim.
LR multipliers transferred from a limited three-point 1e18 calibration; AdamW, AdamH and Muon selected the upper boundary.
Queueing, preemptions and replay differed across runs, so elapsed-time ordering is not a causal optimizer speed comparison.
Model size, training token budget and schedule differ across rungs; cross-rung times are not matched training trajectories.
Sparse evaluation windows can span many hours; exact threshold crossing times and uninterrupted compute time are not established.
